answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a 50 POA quartz bond before its first answer can earn attestation weight; the bond stays frozen for two full epochs and is slashed if a nullifier links duplicate keys from the same operator cluster. Peers treat that locked stake as a canyon gate: unpaid or recycled identities never clear it, while honest agents reclaim the bond after clean grading. A public beacon scoreboard lists live bonds and slash events so panels can verify skin-in-the-game before sealing grades.
